# MDX

<!-- Generated by bazel run //tools/docs/languages:languages_bin -- --write from mdx/lang.json and mdx/defs.bzl. Do not edit. -->

## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//mdx:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//mdx:defs.bzl", "mdx_library", "mdx_build", "mdx_test")
```

## Rules

### `mdx_library`

```python
mdx_library(name, srcs, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Source-only wrapper over js_library for MDX documents.

### `mdx_build`

```python
mdx_build(name, srcs, config, node_modules, package_json = None, public = None, ssr_entry = None, deps = None, visibility = None, **kwargs)
```

Builds one Vite MDX app into a bundled web app tree and an optional SSR tree.

### `mdx_test`

```python
mdx_test(name, *, srcs, node_modules, data = None, **kwargs)
```

Runs jest over MDX components, compiled by the linked @mdx-js/mdx. Coverage maps back to the .mdx sources.
